name: Hop-Constrained Simple Path and Cycle Enumeration
problem_statement: Given a directed graph and a hop bound k, enumerate every simple (vertex-disjoint except endpoints) s-t path with at most k edges, or every simple cycle through a given vertex or edge with at most k edges.

normalization: Remove self-loops; they cannot appear in a simple path or simple cycle of length >= 2.
Collapse parallel directed edges between the same ordered pair to one edge unless multiplicity is explicitly requested.
Reject undirected input unless an explicit directed projection (both directions) is requested.

problem_inputs.name: task
problem_inputs.description: Enumerate bounded-hop simple paths between two vertices, simple cycles through a specific vertex or edge, or every simple cycle up to the hop bound.

problem_inputs.name: source
problem_inputs.description: Required for s_t_path; the path/cycle start vertex for cycle_through_vertex.

problem_inputs.name: max_hops
problem_inputs.description: Maximum number of edges permitted in a returned path or cycle.

problem_inputs.name: result_limit
problem_inputs.description: Maximum number of paths/cycles to return; null means return all, bounded by max_hops and the graph.

problem_inputs.name: chronological_order_required
problem_inputs.description: When true and edges carry timestamps, require strictly increasing timestamps along the path/cycle.

required_outputs.name: paths_or_cycles
required_outputs.description: Each result as an ordered edge sequence forming a simple path or simple cycle within max_hops.

required_outputs.name: complete
required_outputs.description: Whether every qualifying path/cycle was found, or result_limit truncated the search.

optional_outputs.name: vertex_sequences
optional_outputs.description: Vertex sequence corresponding to each returned edge sequence.

optional_outputs.name: shortest_length_found
optional_outputs.description: Minimum hop count among returned results.

solution_semantics.objective: Enumerate every simple path or cycle meeting the task definition and max_hops without omission, up to result_limit and chronological_order_required.
solution_semantics.exactness: complete=true requires no qualifying path/cycle within scope was omitted; complete=false is only acceptable when result_limit truncated output.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Each distinct edge sequence is returned once; a cycle and its distinct rotations starting at different edges are considered the same cycle and returned once using a canonical start edge.
solution_semantics.ordering: paths_or_cycles have no required global ordering unless result_limit is set, in which case shorter paths/cycles are prioritized before truncation.

validation_rules: Every returned sequence is a valid walk in the normalized graph with no repeated vertex (except the shared start/end vertex of a cycle).
Every returned sequence has at most max_hops edges.
s_t_path results start at source and end at target.
cycle_through_vertex and cycle_through_edge results include the specified vertex or edge.
chronological_order_required=true results have strictly increasing edge timestamps.
edge_cases: source equals target is invalid for s_t_path but is exactly the cycle_through_vertex case.
max_hops smaller than the shortest qualifying path/cycle yields an empty, complete result.
A vertex or edge with no incident cycle returns an empty, complete result for the cycle tasks.
Self-loops and multi-edges, once normalized away, never appear in output sequences.

correctness: exhaustive agreement with brute-force DFS enumeration on small/medium fixtures
